jobForm.heroIntro: We are a small team that solves real SME problems with custom software: from management systems to AI assistants that give hours of work back to a business. We care more about understanding the problem well than about using the latest trend, and we like doing it in good company.
jobForm.heroOutro: If you enjoy building useful things, asking “what for?” and growing with people who have your back when something gets stuck, tell us who you are. Every application is read by a member of the team.
